title: Four concurrent tip-drift gate PRs (#152, #153, #154, #155) — consolidation plan so they do not race each other
blocker: Between 19:55Z and 20:19Z four Cursor cloud agents independently diagnosed NA-0001 (strict live==BASE_TIP gate vs a landed, fast-moving hardening branch) and opened four PRs, each with its own gate script and its own edits to the same seven files (ci.yml, refresh_path_c_bundle.sh, assert_path_c_ready.sh, owner_open_path_c_pr.sh, owner_land_path_c.sh, path_c_dry_run.py, write_path_c_status.py) plus tests/test_intent.py: #152 scripts/path_c_tip_drift_tolerance.sh (verdict from apply_all --check already_on_tip on the live tree; adds generic semantic already-applied to apply_all.sh; leaves loop pin tests frozen), #153 scripts/tip_drift_class.py (MATCH/DESCENDANT/BEHIND/DIVERGED; also merges PR #150, refreshes BASE_TIP to 9ce5c66 and rewrites loop-owned VERIFY/MANIFEST/PATH_C_STATUS/STATUS_GUARD — now CONFLICTING with main), #154 scripts/path_c_tip_gate.py (LANDED_ANCESTOR also requires the 0019 merge commit in history; blobless clone cache; wires when_writable_land + alignment_status; ~59 loop pin tests left failing), #155 scripts/tip_drift_gate.py (EXACT/ANCESTOR/DRIFT; git -> compare API -> cached treeless fetch; 0019 merge-commit guard; wires all of the above incl. when_writable_land + alignment_status; test_intent living helpers 144 -> 5 local failures; plus this needs_attention inbox). Whichever lands second will conflict on every one of those files, and the loop keeps appending to tests/test_intent.py every ~2 min.
ask: Land ONE gate, fold the unique extras of the others in as follow-ups instead of merging four overlapping rewrites. Proposed order (any agent or the owner may execute; no approval needed): (1) land #155 first — superset gate (ancestor + landed-commit guard + token-free fallback), all gates/scripts/daemon/dashboard wired, Intent suite de-frozen to 5 pre-existing data-defect failures, and it carries the needs_attention inbox this card lives in. (2) Then #152's apply_all.sh generic semantic already-applied guard + machine-readable summary line is still valuable on its own (it is what makes a real refresh_path_c_bundle.sh run work again on 0017); rebase #152 down to portable/patches/apply_all.sh + its own test module and drop the duplicate gate/CI edits. (3) #153: split — the PR #150 merge should go through #150 itself (now MERGEABLE, NA-0002 resolved); the BASE_TIP refresh 2f7a5a9 -> 9ce5c66 is optional under the ancestor gate (lag is reported, not failed) and rewrites loop-owned files, so only do it via ./scripts/refresh_path_c_bundle.sh after (1)+(2) land; drop its duplicate tip_drift_class.py/CI/test_intent edits. (4) #154: close as superseded once (1) lands, or rebase to only what is not already in #155 (nothing material identified: 0019-merge guard, blobless cache, when_writable/alignment wiring are all in #155 now). If a different gate is preferred, apply the same rule: exactly one gate script referenced by ci.yml (tests/test_needs_attention.py::test_ci_uses_shared_tip_gate enforces this for #155). Do not merge #152+#153+#154+#155 together.
